title: The Last Light
summary: On Day fifteen, the tug at last leaves Pier Four and the long night of Harbor View ends.

beats.text: Biscuit sneezed. On a silent deck, it sounded like a bell.
They poured down the pier. The tug was still tied.
Mrs. Okafor hurled her rattling tin down the pier.
The whole crowd turned and followed it. Dara cut the rope.
Hale opened the throttle. Pier Four slid backwards into the fog.
Marek sat alone below deck. "Sorry," he said. Hale nodded.
Leo fell asleep against Mrs. Okafor, Dara's arm around him.
The radio crackled. "Harbor Station to all boats. Come west. We see you."
beats.speaker: announcer

beats.text: Biscuit stood at the bow, nose in the wind, like the captain.
Behind us, Harbor View shrank into the rain. One window lit. Mine.
Across the water, a lamp blinked back. I held my dog and breathed.
